cards.speaker: cole
cards.text: The chest is empty, the hands unpaid, and I hold the town's debts and now, kindly, yours. I have sent the Company a copy of every note. Commissioner Kell arrives Tuesday. I am telling you so you may prepare a face.

left.label: Pay her something, anything
left.outcome: You sell the good chair and the Company lamp oil. She accepts it, kindly, and withdraws one of the notes.

right.label: Let Kell come
right.outcome: Kell comes. He reads the notes. He says 'regrettably' four times.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The chest cannot meet wages and the Company will not advance them again. There is a fund for 'exceptional maintenance' that nobody audits but me. Wages are not maintenance. I am asking whether the gate is.

left.label: The gate is maintenance
left.outcome: "Noted." Wages appear from a fund that does not exist for wages. She has done this before. Once.

right.label: Don't lie for me
right.outcome: "Noted. I have lied for the Company eleven years. I would have liked to lie for a gate once."

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Three things. Nobody's been paid in three watches. Six hands have gone down the flight to Lock 6 where the Keeper pays. And the five left have asked me to tell you they're staying because of you, not the Company, and they'd like that written down somewhere.

left.label: Write it in the Ledger, with their names
left.outcome: Five names in the Ledger. It has never had lock hands' names in it. They come to see.

right.label: Tell them to go to Lock 6 too
right.outcome: "Right." They don't go. They work unpaid. It is worse than if they'd gone.

cards.speaker: ilse
cards.text: The moot's had a whip-round. For the Keeper's chest. Nobody's ever done that for a Company post. It's not much. It's the town's beer money for a month. Take it and the Company owns nothing here; refuse it and the town'll never offer again.

left.label: Take it
left.outcome: The town's beer money in the Company's chest. Vosk sees the entry. 'Irregular.' She does not strike it.

right.label: Refuse it, gratefully
right.outcome: "Gratefully. Right." The town drinks its beer money and toasts you with it, which is something.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: The Board's view is that a post which cannot pay its hands is a post in default. Regrettably, default has consequences: the account is frozen, the Keeper's salary is suspended, and a Company clerk will keep the Book until the account recovers. Do carry on. Under supervision.

left.label: Accept supervision
left.outcome: A clerk from Ardent at your elbow for a month. He is very young. He counts everything. The account recovers.

right.label: The town will fund the gate
right.outcome: "The town. Regrettably, the Board has no view on the town." The town has one on the Board.

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP ACCOUNT IRREGULARITY NOTED STOP SURPLUS EXCEEDS TOLL CAPACITY STOP BOARD AUDITOR DISPATCHED STOP EXPLAIN BY RETURN STOP

left.label: Remit the surplus tonight
left.outcome: The chest goes east in a strongbox by the last boat. The auditor arrives to find a book that balances.

right.label: 'GIFTS FROM GRATEFUL BARGEES'
right.outcome: The auditor arrives. He asks which bargees. You do not have names.

cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: The chest is neither empty nor suspicious. Wages paid, Cole paid, the Book balanced to the mark. The Ledger's money page has one other hand: 'a Keeper who is rich or poor is noticed. Be neither.'

left.label: Be neither
left.outcome: You write it under the other hand. It is good advice. It is hard.

right.label: Bury a reserve in the false bottom
right.outcome: Twenty marks under Dray's board. Neither rich nor poor. Prepared.

delayed_resources.message: You retrieve the reserve from the false bottom.

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP CONFIDENCE IN SUMMIT WITHDRAWN STOP KEEPER TO SHOW CAUSE WHY APPOINTMENT SHOULD NOT BE REVOKED STOP REPLY WITHIN THE WATCH STOP

left.label: Show cause: the figures
left.outcome: You send the Book's figures. They are honest. They are not good. Ardent replies 'noted'.

right.label: Show cause: the town
right.outcome: You send the moot's letter, Ilse's, Bram's mark, Crane's seal. Ardent has never received such a thing. It does not know what to do with it.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The Board asked me for a name to replace you. I gave one: a clerk in Ardent who has never seen a lock. The Board will take a month to discover this. You will find that is the month I have bought you.

left.label: Use the month
left.outcome: A month. Quiet figures, no letters, the gate at the bell. The Board forgets what is quiet.

right.label: Why buy it?
right.outcome: "Because the clerk would not watch the gauge. You will find I have started to want someone to."

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: I have the revocation in my case. Signed, dated Tuesday. It is Monday. My view, which the Board did not ask for, is that the summit under you has not lost a boat, a hand, or a mark of water it could have kept. Convince me by Tuesday.

left.label: Show him the Ledger
left.outcome: He reads it all night. In the morning: "Regrettably, this is not evidence. It is, however, persuasive." He tears the revocation in half.

right.label: Show him the gate at work
right.outcome: A day at the gate beside you. He does not speak. At dusk he says 'regrettably' and burns the paper in the lock house stove.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: I have been told to prepare the Keeper's house for a successor. I have sat with the order and a pen for two days. Tell me something to write that is not 'no'. I have never written 'no'. I do not know how it is spelled.

left.label: Write 'no'
left.outcome: He writes it. Two letters. He looks at it a long time. He sends it. Ardent is silent for a week, astonished.

right.label: Write 'the house is not ready'
right.outcome: "Not ready. Yes. It can be not ready for months." It is.

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: A wire's come through for the constables at Lock 5. It says your name and 'detain pending inquiry'. I haven't sent it on. I'm meant to. I've been sitting here with it for an hour. Tell me what to do.

left.label: Send it on
left.outcome: "Right. Right." He sends it. The constables come. Vosk meets them at the boundary stone and they go back. You do not know what she said.

right.label: Lose it
right.outcome: "Lost. Yes. I lose things. I've never lost a thing in my life." He loses it. It is the bravest thing he has done.

cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: The Board has stopped writing. Not favorably; silently. The summit runs. The Book balances. Nobody from Ardent has visited in a season. The Ledger's Company page, in Dray's hand, says: 'when they stop writing, they have decided. Find out what.'

left.label: Find out what
left.outcome: Fennick reads the Ardent code for a week. They have decided nothing. They have forgotten the summit. It is the safest you have been.

right.label: Enjoy the silence
right.outcome: You enjoy it. It lasts. Silence from Ardent is the Company's only gift.
